description: This is a PHP test source file for the LeaveOverlapAPI class, part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System, specifically testing API endpoints related to leave overlaps within the leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveOverlapAPI endpoints and validation rules, including test setups and various test cases for getAll method and other API interactions.

methods.name: testDelete

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForDelete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that create method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
